body: claimed: Codex manager (uma) . 2026-11-14 04:15:00 UTC . branch mkinney:issue/1626-same-tool-no-g30 . plan: track the tool changed by this program, suppress repeated G30/M6, and pin retained lift/compensation/clearance with mutation checks.

Decision: track only the tool for which this program emitted M6. The first change remains unconditional; repeated tools skip G30/M6 while G43, the machine-Z lift and the stated clearance traverse remain. A change back to an earlier tool is a real change. Public Tormach post guidelines and 770MX tools documentation do not specify a same-tool M6 exception, so the fix does not rely on one.

Fork process check: root checkout is stale at 52; origin/main is 63, upstream/main is 64. Required process-only sync is prepared as draft mkinney/Camcraft#3; no merge or main push performed. Product work is based on mkinney:issue/1614-toolchange-clearance (#1618), as requested. Fork origin/main contains v0.19.0.

Pinning tests now pass with the fix, and both independently fail when only tormach.cps is restored to parent #1618: repeated_tool_skips_g30_and_m6_but_keeps_compensation_lift_and_clearance sees 2 G30 blocks instead of 1; a_different_tool_and_a_return_to_an_earlier_tool_each_change_again sees 4 instead of 3. Fixed CPS was restored and both pins passed again. Independent local diff read found no blockers. Golden-suite checks and the required quick gate/clippy are next.

The optional sccache wrapper failed with Operation not permitted before running tests; verification uses uncached cargo. Those infrastructure failures are not counted as mutation kills or quick-gate failures. graphify is unavailable on PATH, so its update cannot run.

Escalated #1626 from effort:high to effort:max under work-issue step 4 after two quick-gate failures; releasing the claim. Held work is pushed to mkinney:issue/1626-same-tool-no-g30 at 9a2bbeed8d0c2ebfe0b0bc9814209cde7ebf1040, stacked on #1618. No product PR opened and no in-review transition: the required quick gate is not green. No merge, main/upstream push, force-push, ready flag or PR review performed.

Patch files:
- assets/posts/tormach.cps: remember the tool this program changed to; repeated tools skip G30/M6, while G43/lift/clearance remain. First, different and return-tool changes remain.
- crates/post/tests/tormach_same_tool.rs: two pins, both passing; each fails independently with CPS restored to parent #1618 (G30 counts 2 vs 1 and 4 vs 3). Fixed script restored and both passed again.
- docs/decisions/1626-same-tool-no-g30.md: policy and public-document readings.
- docs/tester-kits/tormach-microarc-4th/microarc_test_part.nc: only moved golden, removes three redundant pre-change lines in second T1 section. Regenerated only failing microarc_test_part suite with WRITE_GOLDEN=1, reviewed all diffs, restored unrelated camproj floating-point noise; normal verification 2/2 pass. No UI snapshots touched.

Passing verification: conformance 7; tormach_fourth_axis 12; tormach_program_end 3; tormach_toolchange_lift 3; tormach_traverse_clearance 4; new pins 2. Required cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings passed. Independent local code/test/golden read found no blockers (no GitHub PR review submitted).

Both quick attempts used cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main. The inherited stack's shared golden inputs select a broad post/app sweep.
- Attempt 1: 15 minutes, post 470 passed; app 2929 passed, 8 failed, 22 ignored. Failures: one import_step_guard timeout, six sandbox-denied mcp_live loopback tests, and the expected microarc_test_part golden mismatch. Corrected the golden; isolated import retry passed in 0.04 s; elevated mcp_live passed 10/10.
- Attempt 2: elevated, post 470 passed; app 985 passed, 2 failed, 4 ignored at interruption. import_step_guard::a_lowered_cap_refuses_the_same_face_at_once and import_step_guard::a_finer_pass_that_runs_out_on_a_face_that_may_jump_is_refused both failed at crates/app/tests/import_step_guard.rs:36 with "import did not finish within 30s - the hang is back". These geometry-import tests are outside this post patch. Stopped the exact gate session after the second failure triggered mandatory escalation (exit 130); no more tests or unrelated fixes attempted. Complete logs retained locally in /tmp/1626-quick-attempt1 and /tmp/1626-quick-attempt2, with targeted logs under /tmp/1626-*.

Not exercised: PathPilot Hub/controller/physical machine (Hub run remains for the user), Windows/macOS, release tier, UI snapshots. Optional sccache failed Operation not permitted; verification ran uncached. graphify unavailable on PATH. Fork process sync prepared separately as draft mkinney/Camcraft#3 (version 64); origin/main contains v0.19.0, and this issue branch's parent already has process 64.

Next worker: pick up the held branch at effort:max, establish why import_step_guard exceeds its bound under the broad gate while the isolated retry passes, then obtain a green required quick gate before opening the requested draft PR. The staged code/test/golden scope is complete; no claim remains held by this session.
